title: Identification of new biomarkers in cardiac ischemia
summary: The aim of the study is to investigate new blood markers for the insufficient supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Therefore, blood from patients is taken before, during and after an imaging-based cardiac stress test. The blood samples are then examined for possible biomarkers and analyzed to what extent these markers are relevant.

interventions.name: Blood from Patients who have a medical indication for an imaging-based cardiac stress test (using MRI or echocardiography) will be taken before, during and after the test. This blood will be examined for possible biomarkers. Arm 1 consists of the patients with a positive stress test result.

Blood from Patients who have a medical indication for an imaging-based cardiac stress test (using MRI or echocardiography) will be taken before, during and after the test. This blood will be examined for possible biomarkers. Arm 2 consists of the patients with a negative stress test result.
